sources.snippet: This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen3-4B (Unsloth 4-bit) optimized for function calling using Unsloth for 2x faster training and 60% less VRAM. Trained on the Salesforce/xlam-function-calling-60k dataset, which contains 60,000 function calling examples with queries, tool definitions, and structured answers.
